query: {company} acquisition merger takeover divestiture sells stake deal
intent: [PERSONA/CONTEXT]: I am an equity research analyst tracking material news specifically about {company}. [INCLUDE]: Prioritize reporting where {company} is a party to an acquisition, merger, takeover, asset sale, or stake change, published recently. [DEPTH]: Focus on the deal terms, counterparties, and strategic rationale for {company}. [EXCLUDE]: Strictly exclude deals {company} is not party to, generic M&A-trend articles, advisory-firm marketing, aggregator/list pages, and look-alike company names.

query: {company} dividend share buyback capital raise bond issuance debt financing
intent: [PERSONA/CONTEXT]: I am an equity research analyst tracking material news specifically about {company}. [INCLUDE]: Prioritize {company}'s dividend declarations, buyback programs, equity/debt raises, and financing actions, published recently. [DEPTH]: Focus on amounts, terms, and balance-sheet implications for {company}. [EXCLUDE]: Strictly exclude generic dividend/investing guides, market-wide rate commentary, aggregator pages, and other issuers' capital actions.

query: {company} restructuring layoffs job cuts cost cutting reorganization
intent: [PERSONA/CONTEXT]: I am an equity research analyst tracking material news specifically about {company}. [INCLUDE]: Prioritize reporting on {company}'s restructuring, layoffs, cost programs, and reorganizations, published recently. [DEPTH]: Focus on scale (headcount, cost savings), affected units, and the rationale for {company}. [EXCLUDE]: Strictly exclude generic layoff-tracker/list pages, national labor-market trend pieces, aggregator pages, and layoffs at other companies.
